recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a new work-group decision specifically asks to change List.note's Annotation/repeatable representation or the current title/notes search parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-5838 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 and requested List.title plus List.comments/List.note for IHE XDS Folder title and comments, resolved as adding title and note as 0..1 strings.
initial_application: No implementation commit explicitly names FHIR-5838, but db4ace37c6615c9732f958d34d6286fe739fc657 added List.title and List.note as 0..1 strings in the List spreadsheet as part of PC-approved List changes shortly after the Jira vote. FHIR-6963 then corrected the List.note short description from 'Comments about the note' to 'Comments about the list'.
additional_context: FHIR-5650 is the XDS Folder parent issue that created FHIR-5838 for title/comments. The current source/fhir.ini actively includes list=List. List.note later evolved from 0..1 string to 0..* Annotation in the broad QA/source update 3d9011ca909323a6703520954c18ee1273f8531c, while List.note.text remains searchable as a string. No relevant Confluence references or Zulip discussion were found that conflicts with this reading.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative List source already satisfies the seed intent. Reverting List.note to a single string would not be supported by the issue family and would remove the modern Annotation representation while preserving no needed semantics.
